title.narrative: Nature based solutions for urban resilience in Colombia

description.narrative: The municipalities, Soacha and La Ceja, are experiencing an accelerated urban growth due to their proximity to the two metropolises, Bogotá and Medellín. Moreover, the average temperature and precipitation are expected to increase in the coming years. Both municipalities are therefore facing serious challenges related to air quality, flooding or degradation of ecosystems. The project strengthened climate resilience in Colombian cities by integrating Nature-Based Solutions (NbS) in urban planning. NbS are understood as a multifunctional strategy for Colombian cities to meet the challenges of climate change, biodiversity loss and urban habitat. The project aimed to support the mayor's office and the community of both cities in urban planning through an integration of NbS. It adjusted and applied a scientific conceptual framework and supported the design and the implementation of at least one NbS in each municipality in collaboration with the local decision makers.
